name: Almighty Sword
description: It is said that an almighty sword once used this Sword in his last battle. It now sits awaiting for the next hero.

name: Copper Sword
description: Any terraria fans? No? Awh.. This copper sword is used for beginners, Gunter produces these the most since plebians keep breaking them.

name: Sovereign Sword
description: It's shiny, strong, made of iron, and has a good handle. This is good for any adventure who dares to join a battle of glory.

name: Duskbringer
description: Not beginner friendly, the dual wielding swords require intensive training to master the art of wielding two swords. It's risky but the reward is worth it.

name: Knight's Plate Armor
description: Knights that charge into battle must protect their body from the slashes and barrage of metal on metal. They protect the vitals, giving one more chance for success.

name: Brigandine
description: Body armor made of small steel plates riveted inside using fabric and other leather materials. Used by Eurpoean soldiers in the 14th century.

name: Leather Cuirass
description: A protective torso piece made from leather to cover the chest and back. These are best for mability while covering the vital areas.
simplified: Stiff torso piece made from leather

name: Knight's Chainmail
description: A flexible armor made of thousands of interlocking metal rings, great protection against slashes and weapons. However less effective against blunt forces.

name: Thick Gambeson
description: A defensive jacket of multiple layers of quilted cloth worn underneath heavy armor like chainmail to absorb blunt impacts. It's also great for the winter time.

name: Mail Coif
description: Similar to the Knight's Chainmail, this hood made of the same material is designed to protect your head, neck, and shoulders against slashes. I recommend wearing a cushion for your head.
simplified: Flexible hood to protect the head and neck
img_alt: Flexible hood to protect the head and neck

name: Cooking Pot
description: A great versatile item. Just throw your scraps of meat, vegatables, seasoning, and base. Then after a while you'll get a meal that's easy to clean later.

name: Cast Iron Skillet
description: Great for carrying around during tough battles where movement is necessary. The coating allows for meals to sustain it's aroma and flavor. It can also be used as a handheld weapon.

name: Butcher's Cleaver
description: After fighting against a boar, you must utilize a butchering cleaver to componentize your kill and feed your allies. Remember to keep it sharp or else everyone will go hungry.

name: Woodle Ladle
description: Mixing, Scooping, and Serving. Typically holds 4 to 6 ounches for soup, however it can carry thicker meals with no problem. Remember to clean it.

name: Stone Mortar
description: Handcrafted by your very blacksmith Gunter. Made of durable granite and useds to crush or grind herbs, spices, and aromatics.
